title: INTRODUCTION
subtitle: Our commitment to your privacy
description: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you visit our website, contact our team, or use our creative services. By accessing our website, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

title: INFORMATION WE COLLECT
subtitle: Information you provide
description: We may collect information you voluntarily provide, including your name, email address, phone number, company details, project information, and any other information submitted through our contact forms or communications.

title: HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
subtitle: Using your information responsibly
description: Your information is used to respond to inquiries, manage projects, improve our services, communicate important updates, and deliver a better overall experience. We never use your information for purposes unrelated to our services without your consent.

title: COOKIES & ANALYTICS
subtitle: Website analytics and cookies
description: Our website may use cookies and analytics tools to understand visitor behavior, improve website performance, and enhance user experience. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

title: DATA PROTECTION
subtitle: Keeping your information secure
description: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure. While we strive to maintain strong security practices, no online system can guarantee absolute protection.

title: THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
subtitle: Trusted third-party providers
description: We may use trusted third-party tools for website hosting, analytics, payment processing, scheduling, or communication. These providers maintain their own privacy policies and data handling practices.

title: YOUR RIGHTS
subtitle: Your privacy choices
description: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, update, correct, or request deletion of your personal information. You may also request information about how your data is processed.

title: POLICY UPDATES
subtitle: Changes to this policy
description: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our services, legal requirements, or business practices. The latest version will always be available on this page.
